calls.content: {"functionName":"isEven","behavior":"isEven(n) returns true for any finite even number (including zero and negatives), false for any finite odd number, and throws Error(\"nan\") when n is not finite."}
{"functionName":"clamp","behavior":"clamp(n, lo, hi) throws Error(\"nan\") when n is not finite; otherwise it returns lo if n < lo, hi if n > hi, and n if it lies within the range."}

{"functionName":"wordCount","behavior":"wordCount(text) returns the number of whitespace-separated words in the text, counting a newline as whitespace and returning 0 for empty or whitespace-only input."}
{"functionName":"safeDiv","behavior":"safeDiv(a, b) returns a/b, but throws Error(\"div0\") when b is zero."}
{"functionName":"slug","behavior":"Converts text to lowercase, replaces each run of non‑letters and non‑digits with a single hyphen, and trims hyphens from both ends."}
